_source: Existing hits of tools/checks/commerce-terms.txt, recorded when the gate was introduced (issue #905). Every entry is copy that already shipped; the ratchet only refuses new ones. Remove an entry when its string is rewritten or deleted: the gate reports a stale entry as a failure until then. Entries whose source starts with `db:` are live-database exemptions, registered from the first full production scan; their source key carries the post ID because Polylang twins share a slug.

plugins/linker-tools/languages/linker-to.string: Import and export limits apply once at the shared AC metering point. In each interval, charging or discharging is shared in proportion to each unit's available power within its declared power and energy limits. The rule uses no forecast, does not request grid charging and does not reproduce a manufacturer EMS or an optimal dispatch schedule.
plugins/linker-tools/languages/linker-to.justification: energy dispatch: the Planner's calculation of when a converter charges or discharges, not a shipment

plugins/linker-tools/languages/linker-to.string: In each interval, each converter supplies its own DC auxiliary demand and its allocated share of AC demand before charging from local DC PV. AC demand is shared in proportion to each unit’s available power. Charging from the AC bus must be enabled and supported by the equipment documentation. It uses remaining AC surplus; grid charging is requested only when separately permitted and within the remaining import limit. This time-step calculation uses no forecast and does not reproduce a manufacturer EMS or an optimal dispatch schedule.
plugins/linker-tools/languages/linker-to.justification: energy dispatch: the Planner's calculation of when a converter charges or discharges, not a shipment
